unit.why: A short anecdote: the tzaddik senses that his Shimusha Rabba tefillin were arranged in Rashi order, and when the tefillin are opened his perception proves correct.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מפי מגידי אמת שהסופר אשר
stories.summary_en: The tzaddik puts on his Shimusha Rabba tefillin and senses they are arranged in Rashi order; the scribe protests that he never errs, but the tefillin are opened and found to be as the tzaddik said.

tags.why: The whole story turns on the arrangement of the tefillin parshiyot.

quotes: שהסופר אשר הי׳ רגיל לסדר לו
tags.why: The sofer who prepares the parshiyot is a character.
He senses the hidden arrangement without seeing it.

quotes: קדש מימין המניח כדעת הרמ״ע בשיטת השמו״ר
tags.why: The halakhic dispute over the order of the parshiyot is the background.
Opening the tefillin confirms the tzaddik's claim against the scribe's protest.

quotes: והסופר צווח ואמר הלא אין זה פעם הראשון
tags.why: The scribe briefly disputes the tzaddik's claim.

missing_concepts: Rashi vs. Rabbenu Tam / Shimusha Rabba tefillin order
verification of a tzaddik's supernatural sensing by physical inspection
